hand-wraps-desert-shamagh.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Desert Shamagh
hand-wraps-desert-shamagh.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching.

moto-gloves-blood-pressure.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure
moto-gloves-blood-pressure.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph.

sport-gloves-omega.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Omega
sport-gloves-omega.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. These synthetic black gloves have strong yellow accents.

ak-47-point-disarray.name: AK-47 | Point Disarray
ak-47-point-disarray.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a geometric hydrographic.

Up close it is chaos... from a distance it is beauty - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

aug-anodized-navy.name: AUG | Anodized Navy
aug-anodized-navy.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. This memento from Ali has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent navy anodized effect paint.

I already lost one man to Valeria's lies... I don't intend to lose anyone else - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

aug-storm.name: AUG | Storm
aug-storm.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a stormy color scheme.

It will be waiting for you at the monorail

bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bayonet-marble-fade.name: ★ Bayonet | Marble Fade
bayonet-marble-fade.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

bayonet-blue-steel.name: ★ Bayonet | Blue Steel
bayonet-blue-steel.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

pp-bizon-traitor.name: PP-Bizon | Traitor
pp-bizon-traitor.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with a bronze and gold design.

Bronze and bullets

pp-bizon-night-riot.name: PP-Bizon | Night Riot
pp-bizon-night-riot.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with a blue camo pattern.

Cause an uproar

pp-bizon-embargo.name: PP-Bizon | Embargo
pp-bizon-embargo.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. Pieced together from found items, it has a teal base and various 1950's Havana advertisements.

¡Chao pescao!

five-seven-scrawl.name: Five-SeveN | Scrawl
five-seven-scrawl.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. Custom designs have been hand-painted using bold strokes over a yellow and teal base.

The first and the last

five-seven-fall-hazard.name: Five-SeveN | Fall Hazard
five-seven-fall-hazard.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A multicolored custom paint job which reads "FALL" and "CONSTRUCTION" has been applied.

Mind the gap

five-seven-sky-blue.name: Five-SeveN | Sky Blue
five-seven-sky-blue.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted a solid, steel-colored blue and finished with silver accents.

Steeling hearts

g3sg1-jungle-dashed.name: G3SG1 | Jungle Dashed
g3sg1-jungle-dashed.desc: The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

galil-ar-tuxedo.name: Galil AR | Tuxedo
galil-ar-tuxedo.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and white color scheme.

For when combat is a black tie affair

glock-18-moonrise.name: Glock-18 | Moonrise
glock-18-moonrise.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A randomized city landscape in the foreground gives way to a full moon and purple night sky.

Look for the North Star

glock-18-pink-ddpat.name: Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT
glock-18-pink-ddpat.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

p2000-space-race.name: P2000 | Space Race
p2000-space-race.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A space themed pattern consisting of stars and satellites has been applied.

Send and receive

butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Gamma Doppler
butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

paracord-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Urban Masked
paracord-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

classic-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Classic Knife | Urban Masked
classic-knife-urban-masked.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

falchion-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

gut-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Gut Knife | Crimson Web
gut-knife-crimson-web.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

karambit-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-phase-4.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Karambit | Gamma Doppler
karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

m9-bayonet-damascus-steel.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Damascus Steel
m9-bayonet-damascus-steel.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has some damascus steel parts.

m9-bayonet-black-laminate.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Black Laminate
m9-bayonet-black-laminate.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

m9-bayonet-forest-ddpat.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Forest DDPAT
m9-bayonet-forest-ddpat.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler
shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

shadow-daggers-marble-fade.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Marble Fade
shadow-daggers-marble-fade.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

shadow-daggers-blue-steel.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Blue Steel
shadow-daggers-blue-steel.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

skeleton-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel
skeleton-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has some damascus steel parts.

skeleton-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Forest DDPAT
skeleton-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-bright-water.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Bright Water
huntsman-knife-bright-water.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

huntsman-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Safari Mesh
huntsman-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

ursus-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Crimson Web
ursus-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

m4a4-the-battlestar.name: M4A4 | The Battlestar
m4a4-the-battlestar.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. All corners have been cut off the receipt of purchase.

Beware those who speak of the watchtower

m4a1-s-chanticos-fire.name: M4A1-S | Chantico's Fire
m4a1-s-chanticos-fire.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been hand painted in vibrant colors and accentuated by a smiley face on the stock.

Protect what is yours

mac-10-neon-rider.name: MAC-10 | Neon Rider
mac-10-neon-rider.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with the image of a deadly biker.

One part firearm, two parts Trapper Keeper

mac-10-saiba-oni.name: MAC-10 | Saibā Oni
mac-10-saiba-oni.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a cybernetic demon on the side and between the wire stock.

Crackling energy and cold steel

mp7-tall-grass.name: MP7 | Tall Grass
mp7-tall-grass.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. A green grass hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Nothing good ever happens in tall grass

mp7-olive-plaid.name: MP7 | Olive Plaid
mp7-olive-plaid.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a beige and olive green plaid pattern.

I like it.  It brings out my eyes on camera... - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

negev-raw-ceramic.name: Negev | Raw Ceramic
negev-raw-ceramic.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted a solid tan color.

Restore by force

nova-clear-polymer.name: Nova | Clear Polymer
nova-clear-polymer.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted to look like its casing is transparent, allowing you to see inside the weapon.

Your goals are clear

nova-sobeks-bite.name: Nova | Sobek's Bite
nova-sobeks-bite.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. This custom paint job features gold and black Egyptian inspired designs.

From the water comes chaos

nova-tempest.name: Nova | Tempest
nova-tempest.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. This memento from Seaside has been painted with a wave and cloud motif hydrographic.

A storm is coming

p250-inferno.name: P250 | Inferno
p250-inferno.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A custom paint job which reflects the ethos of de_inferno has been applied.

"But look at the time!"

p250-boreal-forest.name: P250 | Boreal Forest
p250-boreal-forest.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

p250-sleet.name: P250 | Sleet
p250-sleet.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. An angular grayscale pattern has been applied.

Rich interiors suited for rough exteriors

p250-sand-dune.name: P250 | Sand Dune
p250-sand-dune.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a sand dune color scheme.

With Turner dead, we have a new priority: rescue Alex Kincaide - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

p90-facility-negative.name: P90 | Facility Negative
p90-facility-negative.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A blue and yellow hydrographic pattern resembling a nuclear power plant has been applied.

The opposite of a containment structure

r8-revolver-bone-forged.name: R8 Revolver | Bone Forged
r8-revolver-bone-forged.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. The grip of this revolver has been custom painted with the remains of an ancient sea creature.

What lurks below

sawed-off-runoff.name: Sawed-Off | Runoff
sawed-off-runoff.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. Parts of this Sawed-Off have been lightly color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A "brown shotgun" with a twist

scar-20-emerald.name: SCAR-20 | Emerald
scar-20-emerald.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. This memento from Chinatown has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent emerald anodized effect paint.

This is what the great Sebastien Hennequet has been reduced to? A nagging school marm?  What happened to you... - The Teacher and The Iconoclast Part 2

sg-553-basket-halftone.name: SG 553 | Basket Halftone
sg-553-basket-halftone.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. An orange halftone pattern has been applied.

Cross your hatch and hope to die

ssg-08-carbon-fiber.name: SSG 08 | Carbon Fiber
ssg-08-carbon-fiber.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic over a graphite base coat.

Just because I carried my team doesn't mean it wasn't a team effort - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

ssg-08-dark-water.name: SSG 08 | Dark Water
ssg-08-dark-water.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been painted in an aquatic-stripe pattern with charcoal metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

Water gives life, but it can also take it...

tec-9-blue-titanium.name: Tec-9 | Blue Titanium
tec-9-blue-titanium.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has a titanium parts whose blue color is characteristic of an oxide layer achieved via controlled anodization at 30 volts.

ump-45-fade.name: UMP-45 | Fade
ump-45-fade.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

ump-45-carbon-fiber.name: UMP-45 | Carbon Fiber
ump-45-carbon-fiber.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic over a graphite base coat.

Just because I carried my team doesn't mean it wasn't a team effort - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

ump-45-grand-prix.name: UMP-45 | Grand Prix
ump-45-grand-prix.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted with an old-fashioned racing motif.

Don't forget your helmet

usp-s-dark-water.name: USP-S | Dark Water
usp-s-dark-water.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been painted in an aquatic-stripe pattern with charcoal metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

Water gives life, but it can also take it...

xm1014-red-leather.name: XM1014 | Red Leather
xm1014-red-leather.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. Its stock and grip have been wrapped in red leather.

Pack your baags.  Let's go kill that sonofabitch... - The Oni and The Valkyrie Part 2

xm1014-jungle.name: XM1014 | Jungle
xm1014-jungle.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. This memento from Ruins has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a jungle color scheme.

For those with an appetite for destruction

navaja-knife.name: ★ Navaja Knife
navaja-knife.desc: This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade.

nomad-knife.name: ★ Nomad Knife
nomad-knife.desc: This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material.
